    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">C#脚本引擎之AScript与Flee对比</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2 id="h_2072734127489656342_0" data-first-child="" data-into-catalog-status="">一 简介</h2>
<h3 id="h_2072734127489656342_1" data-into-catalog-status="">1、AScript</h3>
<p data-pid="l70OT3Xn">AScript是一个开源的C#动态脚本解析执行引擎，支持自定义语法，支持扩展多种脚本语言（目前已支持C#/Python3/SQL/JavaScript/Lua五种语言），支持解释执行和编译执行两种执行模式，并且支持编译缓存，以适配不同场景下对性能的要求。</p>
<p data-pid="lAOtJj0J">目前官方最新版本：1.6.0</p>
<p data-pid="eAec5rsR">开源地址：</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="eAec5rsR"><a title="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" href="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript</a></li>
<li data-pid="eAec5rsR"><a title="https://github.com/rockey627/AScript" href="https://github.com/rockey627/AScript" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/rockey627/AScript</a></li>
</ul>
<h3 id="h_2072734127489656342_2" data-into-catalog-status="">2、Flee</h3>
<p data-pid="-xDvuthO">Flee是一个用于. NET框架的表达式解析器和求值器，可以在运行时计算字符串表达式的值(如：sqrt(a^2 + b^2)，其中a、b是变量)它的解析和计算速度是比较快和高效的。</p>
<p data-pid="v1R2EIzd">目前官方最新版本：2.0.0</p>
<p data-pid="q22UKEP_">相关文章：</p>
<p data-pid="eRbMuddh"><a class="internal" href="https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/575448149" data-draft-type="text-link" data-za-detail-view-id="1043" rel="noopener nofollow">.NET 中表达式动态解析和计算 Flee 用起来真香</a></p>
<h2 id="h_2072734127489656342_3" data-into-catalog-status="">二 性能测试</h2>
<p data-pid="ysYJjYTU">使用Benchmark工具进行性能基准测试，测试环境：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">

<h3 id="h_2072734127489656342_4" data-into-catalog-status="">1、常量表达式</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 待测试表达式</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">100 * (5 + 5) * (6-2)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用于测试结果比较，确保测试执行结果是正确的</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> r = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span> * (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span> + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>) * (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span> - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>);</pre>

<p data-pid="AAMv8k1C">4）编译执行（缓存委托）</p>
<p data-pid="89MmfQnK">此为通用缓存场景，根据字符串表达式缓存编译生成的委托，提高整体性能。AScript已内置缓存功能，Flee需手动添加缓存逻辑。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script _Script4;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[Benchmark]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AScript4_Cache()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (_Script4 == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>         _Script4 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AScript.Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = _Script4.Eval&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;(s, -<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (result != r) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Exception(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">result error</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> ConcurrentDictionary&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, Flee.PublicTypes.IGenericExpression&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;&gt; _LeeExpr4Dict = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ConcurrentDictionary&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, Flee.PublicTypes.IGenericExpression&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[Benchmark]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Flee4()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> key =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> s;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!_LeeExpr4Dict.TryGetValue(key, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> d))

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span>         d = context.CompileGeneric&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(s);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span>         _LeeExpr4Dict[key] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> d;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> d.Evaluate();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (result != r) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Exception(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">result error</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="OCKqdnoR">5）编译执行（委托变量）</p>
<p data-pid="JKukajGn">此场景为对固定字符串表达式进行编译生成委托，然后再调用（比如循环调用），来提高性能。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> Func&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _func5;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[Benchmark]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AScript5()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (_func5 == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AScript.Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>         _func5 = script.Compile&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(s);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _func5();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (result != r) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Exception(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">result error</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> Flee.PublicTypes.IGenericExpression&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _LeeExpr5;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (_LeeExpr5 == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p>测试结果如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/417450/202608/417450-20260819214916145-1787182521.png" alt="207af8e1aebab349e58171bfb29df19d_v2-541a2a9da001406494a3aab81b0b7573_1440w_source=ccfced1a" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;<span style="font-style: italic">小结：</span></p>
<ul class="public-DraftStyleDefault-ul" data-offset-key="onvv-0-0">
<li class="Editable-styled public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-reset public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR" data-block="true" data-editor="5f4du" data-offset-key="onvv-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="onvv-0-0"><span data-offset-key="onvv-0-0">解释执行模式对比编译执行模式有一定优势，因为编译生成委托成本比较大。</span></div>
</li>
<li class="Editable-styled public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR" data-block="true" data-editor="5f4du" data-offset-key="3mc8m-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="3mc8m-0-0"><span data-offset-key="3mc8m-0-0">编译不缓存委托场景，AScript比Flee性能高，内存占用低。</span></div>
</li>
<li class="Editable-styled public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR" data-block="true" data-editor="5f4du" data-offset-key="70lrq-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="70lrq-0-0"><span data-offset-key="70lrq-0-0">编译缓存委托场景，AScript和Flee相差不大。</span></div>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="h_2072734127489656342_5" data-into-catalog-status="">2、变量表达式</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 待测试表达式，包含a、b、c三个变量</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a * (b + 5) * (c-2)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用于测试结果比较，确保测试执行结果是正确的</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> r = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span> * (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span> + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>) * (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span> - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>);</pre>

<p>测试结果如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/417450/202608/417450-20260819215030838-1473980519.png" alt="8a9266c66aa774491c419225bbe2a8f5_v2-f8eeeaf7bf826cf50827167c39765edb_1440w_source=ccfced1a" loading="lazy"></p>
<p data-pid="qGn_2Q5Z">小结：</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="tz7d5eq3">解释执行模式对比编译执行模式有一定优势。</li>
<li data-pid="A-lQArpf">编译无缓存模式，AScript性能比Flee高。</li>
<li data-pid="Dpynr48V">编译缓存模式，Flee性能比AScript略微高一点，Flee通过IL生成委托，而AScript通过表达式树生成委托，并且需要支持多语句，所以编译时会定义临时变量来获取上下文中的变量，再进行后续语句执行。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="h_2072734127489656342_6" data-into-catalog-status="">3、函数表达式</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 待测试表达式</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Sum(10, 5)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用于测试结果比较，确保测试执行结果是正确的</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> r = MyFunctions.Sum(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> a +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> b;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="yoShTdov">同样分5个测试场景：</p>
<p data-pid="rWwnWt2g">1）解释执行</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[Benchmark]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AScript1()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AScript.Script();

<p>测试结果如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/417450/202608/417450-20260819215046210-1073636101.png" alt="5ef86e607f823aca92a625c6dcb41d0d_v2-1e19454239b1d626d698807e5bf7b5cc_1440w_source=ccfced1a" loading="lazy"></p>
<p data-pid="DBKPZTGM">小结：</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="V9ok8wGy">解释执行模式对比编译执行模式有一定优势。</li>
<li data-pid="qVaXzBxG">编译无缓存模式，AScript性能比Flee高。</li>
<li data-pid="fKoG9Oxt">编译缓存模式，AScript与Flee性能相差不大，AScript低内存占用。</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3 id="h_2072734127489656342_7" data-into-catalog-status="">4、多语句（表达式组合）</h3>
<p data-pid="zpqi9Onf">AScripit支持多语句，Flee通过表达式组合方式实现。</p>
<p data-pid="dKCVQQPw">另外，AScript默认是回写临时变量的，所以要关闭变量回写功能，与Flee执行逻辑保持一致。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> AScript待测试脚本</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">int m = a * (b + 5) * (c-2); int n = b + a / 10 -c; m + n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用于测试结果比较，确保测试执行结果是正确的</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> r = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span> * (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span> + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>) * (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span> - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>) + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span> + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span> / <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span> - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span>;</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="4UFqbcAZ">分4个测试场景，由于Flee的表达式组合方式不支持缓存，仅测试AScript的编译缓存模式。</p>

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span>

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AScript4_Cache()

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>         _Script4 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AScript.Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>         _Script4.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p>测试结果如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/417450/202608/417450-20260819215102264-1436177224.png" alt="5a8eb0564afa40312483ef6effcdc181_v2-d487154846b6df3c1a053f96603e4dc9_1440w_source=ccfced1a" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;小结：</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="wVM6aXsJ">解释执行模式对比编译执行模式有一定优势。</li>
<li data-pid="QZxJutgT">编译执行模式，AScript比Flee性能高，内存占用低。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="h_2072734127489656342_8" data-into-catalog-status="">三 总结</h2>
<p data-pid="seTs9jKs">从功能、应用场景、性能、内存占用等方面，AScript对比Flee都有绝对的优势：</p>
<p data-pid="-2UdUyMV">1）AScript不创建完整语法树，而是边解析表达式边计算，减少节点创建，并且使用节点池来复用节点，达到低内存高性能的优势。</p>
<p data-pid="wRlBG2Vm">2）AScript默认为解释执行模式，不缓存也能有较高的性能。</p>
<p data-pid="SO60-Ply">3）AScript内置编译缓存功能，支持缓存版本号和定时缓存，不同应用场景使用合适的缓存策略，来提高项目整体性能。</p>
<p data-pid="jjB4QMxe">4）AScript支持多语句、变量/函数定义，让脚本更灵活。</p>
<p data-pid="33RybBvV">5）AScript支持扩展多种脚本语言（目前已支持C#/Python3/SQL/JavaScript/Lua五种语言），项目擅长什么脚本语言就用什么语言，提高脚本配置效率。</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="q_Cq8zcc"><a class="internal" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/22454219" data-draft-type="text-link" data-icon-name="zhicon_icon_24_paper_plain_text" data-za-detail-view-id="1043">基于AScript的Lua脚本语言发布啦</a></li>
<li data-pid="XLEUJkL6"><a class="internal" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/21601395" data-draft-type="text-link" data-icon-name="zhicon_icon_24_paper_plain_text" data-za-detail-view-id="1043">基于AScript的JavaScript脚本语言发布啦</a></li>
<li data-pid="wjw7HduM"><a class="internal" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/20385305" data-draft-type="text-link" data-icon-name="zhicon_icon_24_paper_plain_text" data-za-detail-view-id="1043">基于AScript的SQL脚本语言发布啦！</a></li>
<li data-pid="Ut7rgRmJ"><a class="internal" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/19971851" data-draft-type="text-link" data-icon-name="zhicon_icon_24_paper_plain_text" data-za-detail-view-id="1043">基于AScript的python3脚本语言</a></li>

<p data-pid="SAq6pDK5">6）AScript支持自定义语法，可在项目中定制自己的语法。</p>
